_about: Game rules. Every number the engine uses lives here. Change, reload, start a new game (a saved game keeps the rules it started with).

board._about: Patients are square maps this many squares a side (even), each starting on one of the four middle squares. Curses turn the map about its middle, so the start moves too.

deck._about: Each element moves in a straight line its own way (elements: air up, earth down, water left, fire right), exactly as many squares as the card says. straight = copies per element of each length; diagonal = copies of each length for each pair of neighbouring elements, which move diagonally between their two ways, slip past oni on the way and count as either element. The kitsune moves one square any way, diagonals too.

patients._value: A patient is worth (steps from the centre - 1), plus bonusValue if it has bonusAtOni or more oni.
patients._ailmentKinds: How many different ailments are in play each game (fewer = more repeats for known cures). null = all.
patients._requireElement: A cure needs at least one ingredient of the patient's element (Kitsune Tail counts as any).

ward._about: Cured patients join your ward; each can leap like a knight (2 squares one way and 1 to the side, any way, over anything between). uses: times each can be played (null = once every brew, like a garden card).

knownCure._about: Cure a patient whose ailment you have cured before, without ingredients, for payout x its value (rounded down, at least 1). Spends that ward patient's move.

guilds._about: echo: once per brew, one garden card of your guild's element may be played twice.

tools._about: Paid with fame. effect: turn (play a card rotated by one of 'turns' quarter turns), stretch (play a card 'by' squares longer or shorter), step (one free step any way), gather (take 'amount' cards when gathering or drawing blind). Each works once per brew. copies: how many of each exist; null = players - 1.

abilities._about: What a character's ability changes, as additions to the rules above for that player only. Themes decide which character has which ability. Keys: gardenMax, handLimit, startHand, oniPerPlayer, gather, sakuraBonus, toolCost, startFame, startGarden, swap (hand-for-market swaps a turn).

bot._about: The rival stops buying tools once it is this close to winning.
